Friendzy / Classic party games / Time Traveler

How to play Time Traveler

Pick a decade. Survive it. Everyone is transported to the same historical period. Discuss what you'd do to survive, succeed, or cause chaos. Vote on who would actually thrive — and who would be immediately arrested.

2–10 players~10 minCreative & GeekySocial & discussion games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Group picks a time period (e.g., Medieval Europe, 1920s New York, Ancient Rome).
  2. Each player describes their plan for surviving or thriving in that era.
  3. They have 60 seconds to pitch their strategy.
  4. Group votes on: who would thrive, who would survive, and who would be immediately eliminated.
  5. Rotate time periods.

Example round

  • Medieval England — someone immediately claims to be a 'plague doctor'. Suspicious.
  • Ancient Rome — one person's plan is entirely about the food. Accepted.
  • 1980s Wall Street — someone has a suspiciously detailed plan. The group is concerned.

Tips

  • Pick specific micro-eras for more detail: not just '1800s' but 'Gold Rush California, 1849'.
  • Add a twist: you can only bring three modern items. What do you take?
